title: Time-sensitive activities
html:
Time sensitive activities are activities which automatically end based on the party moving to a certain location, completing a quest, or performing a number of long rests.

General trigger points

There are various points in the game where a pop up appears asking the party if they wish to proceed to the next area and suggesting they tie up loose ends. If the party proceeds on, this causes many interactions and events to automatically resolve. These major choke points are:

  • Entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail for the first time
  • Entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands
  • Entering the Shadowfell
  • Leaving the Shadow-Cursed Lands for Baldur's Gate at the end of Act Two
  • Entering the Morphic Pool at the end of Act Three

Time sensitive interactions

Act One

Recruiting Shadowheart on the Ravaged Beach
Trigger: Completing the prologue after rescuing  Shadowheart.
Length: Shadowheart will wake up and leave for the Emerald Grove alone if not interacted with before going to camp, fast travelling, or entering the Grove.
Rescuing Lae'zel from the tieflings
Trigger: Get rid of the tieflings that have caught  Lae'zel in the cage.
Length: If the the cage is not destroyed, Lae'zel breaks herself free after some time. If the player character is not present when she breaks herself free (even if companions are) or otherwise does not recruit her, she disappears and later appears at the Mountain Pass, with one final opportunity to recruit her.
First night contemplation
Trigger: Resting for the first time.
Length: Leaving the crash site.
Ceremorphosis discussion 1
 Gale in front of the fire in Camp
Trigger: Resting for the first time.
Length: Entering the Emerald Grove or the Forest.
Ceremorphosis discussion 2
Gale examining his mirror image in Camp
Trigger: Resting after the first ceremorphosis discussion or entering the Emerald Grove.
Length: Entering the Forest.
Ceremorphosis discussion 3
Trigger: Resting after talking to either  Zorru with Lae'zel,  Nettie or  Sazza.
Length: Entering the Forest.
Bugbear assassinates Nadira
Trigger: Approaching  Nadira's location.
Length: The  Bugbear immediately begins sneaking up to Nadira and sneak attacks her unless the party initiate combat.
Ethel's shop in the Druid Grove
Trigger: Entering the Emerald Grove
Length:  Ethel leaves the Grove after the party enter the Sunlit Wetlands or after she is robbed for the first time (regardless of whether the player got caught or not) or if  Pandirna reveals that she is paralyzed because of Ethel's potion.
True Soul Edowin's family
Trigger: Approaching  Edowin's location.
Length: Edowin's siblings leave after returning to camp or fast travel.
Dark Urge's kill
Trigger: Crossing the bridge or stream towards the Blighted Village.
Length: Long resting leads to  Alfira's demise or, if Alfira is already dead or knocked-out, it leads to  Quill's death. If this event is not triggered by the time the party enter Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands, a Long Rest is automatically imposed; the Urge cannot skip this killing.
Owlbear Cave
Trigger: If  Andrick and  Brynna are convinced to hunt the owlbear, they wait for the party outside the cave mouth. If ignored, they eventually enter the cave by themselves and start fighting the owlbear.
Interacting with the  Owlbear in the Owlbear Nest.
Length: The owlbear dies after one long rest.
Aradin and his gang
Trigger: Approaching  Aradin near the entrance to the Blighted Village if he decides to leave the Emerald Grove.
Length: Aradin and his band of adventurers leave after one long rest or fast travel.
Dying illithid
Trigger: Starting Act One
Length:
Entering the Emerald Grove, the illithid will already be dead and the party only find the body.
Entering the Shattered Sanctum, the goblins steal the illithid's corpse for  Dror Ragzlin to commune with. This occurs even if the party take the illithid's corpse.

Act Two

Dolly Thrice
Trigger: Acquiring  Kar'niss' Moonlantern.
Length:  Dolly Thrice dies if the party does not free her before entering Act Three.

Act Three

Saving Geraldus from doppelgangers
Trigger: Entering Wyrm's Crossing
Length:  Geraldus is killed and the basement is empty if the Lower City is entered before entering the basement
Interacting with Devella
Trigger: Saving  Cora by defeating  Dolor at the Lower City Wine Festival before meeting with  Devella Fountainhead.
Length: If the party long rest without talking to Devella, she disappears from the game and they cannot witness any of the cut-scenes with her or update her on any quest progress in the Basilisk Gate Barracks. While interacting with Devella is usually a significant part of ⁠Investigate the Murders, it is not necessary to interact with her at all to progress or complete the quest.

Time sensitive Quests

See also: Time-Sensitive Quests

Companion Quests

In Case of Death...
Trigger:  Gale dies for the first time, while his orb is still not stabilised.
Length: Gale is not resurrected for three long rests.
The Githyanki Warrior
Trigger: Approaching the githyanki patrol with  Lae'zel in the party, following the cutscene.
Length:
Lae'zel dies after fast travelling or long resting if  Kith'rak Voss is not spoken to.
Travelling to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail before or after the trigger causes the patrol to disappear.
Our Fiery Friend
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length:  Karlach leaves the party if  Anders and the Paladins of Tyr are not killed for Hunt the Devil and the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Act One

Explore the Ruins
Trigger:
Approaching the Chapel Entrance north of the Overgrown Ruins at X: 287 Y: 332, either falling through the cracked stone or using the door.
A hatch on a nearby cliff at X: 317 Y: 363
Lockpicking the Ancient Door at X: 284 Y: 305 northeast of the Overgrown Ruins waypoint with a  DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check, then use the heavy oak doors to enter the crypt.
Length:  Withers disappears from the tomb after entering the courtyard of the goblin camp.
Find the Missing Shipment
Trigger: Approaching the cave on the Risen Road.
Length: One long rest results in  Rugan and  Olly being killed by the gnolls.
Investigate the Beach
Trigger: Approaching the beach north of the Inner Sanctum.
Length: Completing a long rest causes  Mirkon to die.
Notes: Mirkon dies if not rescued before Defeat the Goblins is completed, even if Investigate the Beach is never triggered.
Raid the Grove
Trigger: Talking with  Sazza and  Minthara (Save the Goblin Sazza) or informing Minthara of the Emerald Grove's location.
Length: The goblin leaders disappear after one long rest.
Rescue the Gnome
Trigger: Approaching windmill in the Blighted Village.
Length: After the party enter Grymforge, the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or travel to the Shadow-Cursed Lands,  Barcus Wroot dies and his corpse can be found in the Blighted Village.
Rescue the Grand Duke
Trigger: Approaching Waukeen's Rest.
Length: Long resting or fast travelling or entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail after approaching Waukeen's Rest, causes the trapped survivors to die.
Rescue the Trapped Man
Trigger: Approaching Waukeen's Rest.
Length: Long resting or fast travelling or entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail after approaching Waukeen's Rest, causes  Benryn to die.
Rescue the Druid Halsin
Trigger: Learning about Halsin being last seen in the Goblin Camp.
Length: Entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands causes Halsin to die in his cell. If he is freed but the party does not not celebrate or long rest before passing a trigger point, Halsin's quest can still be completed. See Rescue the Druid Halsin.
Save Arabella
Trigger: Approaching the Inner Sanctum of the Emerald Grove.
Length: Completing Defeat the Goblins or Raid the Grove.
Save the Goblin Sazza
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length:
Completing Defeat the Goblins or Raid the Emerald Grove causes Sazza to die.
Entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before finishing the quests causes this quest to complete with the following journal entry: "We didn't free Sazza. Who knows what happened to her?"
Save the Refugees
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length: Entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
If the party leave without completing Investigate Kagha, the Rite of Thorns is completed, blocking all outsiders from the Emerald Grove.
If the party leave after completing Investigate Kagha, but before finishing Defeat the Goblins, the grove will still be accessible, but the tieflings will be gone. The journal entry says: "We left without helping the tieflings. They'll likely die on the road."
If the party enter the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands after completing Defeat the Goblins but before taking a long rest to trigger the celebration that night, the same effect will be produced.
Notes: The completion of the Rite of Thorns is not tied to long rests.
Cure the Poisoned Gnome
Trigger: Approaching  Thulla at Ebonlake Grotto.
Length: Thulla becomes a myconid husk after three long rests.
Free True Soul Nere
Trigger: Interacting with the rubble in Grymforge.
Length: Fast traveling or long resting more than once causes  Nere to die.
Save the Grymforge Gnomes
Trigger: Interacting with the rubble in Grymforge.
Length: Fast traveling or long resting more than once causes the gnomes to disappear.
Deliver Nere's Head
Trigger: Freeing True Soul Nere from the rubble.
Length: Fast traveling or long resting once causes  Nere to disappear.

Act Two

Find Rolan in the Shadows
Trigger: After beginning Resolve the Abduction, approaching  Rolan's location in the Ruined Battlefield.
Length: If the location is approached, combat between Rolan and the shadows begins immediately, and he is slain if the party does not intervene in time.
Lift the Shadow Curse
Trigger: After Wake up Art Cullagh is completed and  Halsin opens the portal to the Shadowfell to rescue  Thaniel.
Length: The portal must be protected for four combat turns.
Meeting Florrick
Trigger: Arriving at Last Light Inn.
Length: After one long rest,  Florrick leaves Last Light Inn, leaving behind a letter.
Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse
Obtaining the Moonlantern
Trigger: After Resolve the Abduction, approaching the Harpers near the entrance of the Last Light Inn (if Follow the Convoy was not completed)
Length:
Rescue the Tieflings
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length: Entering the Shadowfell as part of Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic.
Rescue Wulbren
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length: Entering the Shadowfell as part of Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic.
Point of no return
All maps prior to the Shadow-Cursed Lands become inaccessible after entering the Shadowfell as part of Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic.

Act Three

Free Counsellor Florrick
Trigger: Reading the Execution Notices posted around the Lower City or speaking to  Duke Ravengard and getting him to reveal the execution during  Gortash's coronation.
Length: Counsellor Florrick is executed after the fifth long rest.
Help the Devilish Ox
Trigger: Meeting the  Strange Ox in Rivington.
Length: Entering the Lower City.
The High Harper
Meeting the Harpers
Length: If the party enter the Lower City without having met with  Jaheira's contact at Danthelon's Dancing Axe, she receives a messenger rat at camp. Talking to her reveals the hideout was overrun by doppelgangers, though she still asks for help finding  Minsc.
Investigate the Murders
 Cora Highberry's death
Trigger: Either the party enters the Murder Tribunal, OR the party has read the Bloodstained Parchment and has approached the proximity of the Wine Festival in the Lower City.
Length: One long rest.
 Figaro Pennygood's death
Trigger: Starting Impress the Murder Tribunal.
Length: If the party enters the Murder Tribunal by providing a hand of a murder victim, Dolor automatically completes his killing quest by murdering Figaro.[verify]
Save the Gondians
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length: After arriving at the Iron Throne, 6 turns (5 on Tactician difficulty, 8 on Explorer) or completing Avenge the Ironhands without visiting the Iron Throne.
Rescue the Grand Duke
Trigger: The party attends Gortash's coronation without attacking him and spoke to  Mizora on the bridge or during a long rest.
Length: After arriving at the Iron Throne, 6 turns (5 on Tactician difficulty, 8 on Explorer) or completing Avenge the Ironhands without visiting the Iron Throne.
Notes: If Wyll agrees to sell his soul to  Zariel for all eternity, Mizora resurrects Duke Ravengard regardless of whether he dies.
Retrieve Omeluum
Trigger: Start of quest.
Length: After arriving at the Iron Throne, 6 turns (5 on Tactician difficulty, 8 on Explorer) or completing Avenge the Ironhands without visiting the Iron Throne.
Stop the Presses
Trigger: Speaking to  Ettvard Needle after initiating the quest.
Length: The party's reputation is tarnished after one long rest unless the paper is altered or Ettvard is killed.
Notes: If the party defeats Gortash without talking to Ettvard, the news of Gortash's death supersedes the article about the heroes and their reputation is not tarnished.

Notes

  • Although Rescue Orin's Victim appears to be time-sensitive, it is not. The party can take an unlimited number of long rests without Orin killing her kidnapping victim. The companion's life is only at risk once Orin is spoken to in the Temple of Bhaal.
  • The vampire ambush of  Astarion is not time-sensitive or related to meeting the vampires at Fraygo's Flophouse - it occurs as a random long rest event after entering the Lower City.
